steps.caption: Your watchlist, with real-time prices streaming in.
Pick a stock and everything about it is on one page: chart, news, live trades, holders, valuation.
Holders: every fund that disclosed a position in SEC 13F filings, with what it bought or sold last quarter.
Ownership changes: fund moves, 5%+ owners and insider trades in one dated feed.
Valuation: a DCF pre-filled from the company's own SEC filings, each input sourced.
Risk analytics: volatility, Sharpe, drawdown and beta, calculated by Goldman Sachs' open-source GS Quant.
Time and sales: every trade print with VWAP and a buy/sell estimate, or the last session's when the market is closed.
Suppliers and customers, traced from annual reports with the evidence attached.
The whole S&P 500 at a glance: sized by market cap, coloured by today's move.
Click any company to open its stock page.
Or type a terminal-style command: MSFT HDS.
